records.inherited_baseline: the nine-rank system already carried strong status inequality; this inherited defect is not itself scored against the ruler
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: the existing Taixue could sustain thousands of students while a separate elite school could be added without closing the broader layer
records.background_trend: inherited nine-rank exclusion is baseline; only ruler-window enrollment restriction and school stratification are consumed
records.attributable_change: 泰始八年太学生七千余人中仅留已试经者，其余遣还，并令大臣子弟堪受教者入学；咸宁二年另起国子学，随后形成面向高品官僚子弟的独立教育层级。本人确实强化教育身份分层，但太学并未整体关闭，新增国子学本身仍增加部分供给
records.field_coverage: central higher education access and student composition, with continued Taixue operation and added elite Guozixue
records.access_expansion: MIXED: additional elite supply paired with reduced and more status-stratified broader access
records.durability_and_handoff: the dual Taixue-Guozixue structure endured, while later explicit fifth-rank admission rules belong to the successor window

counterevidence.summary: 太学生遣还与教育身份分层为N2，新增国子学的真实供给为独立P1；P1−N2=−1，取CIV1-LOW。太学继续运行，不按全面撤销教育网络计；即使保留H2，负向下限仍只是CIV1，不支持原CIV2。

source_refs: 《晋书·武帝纪》泰始八年、咸宁二年

public_evidence_items.public_boundary: 这里只报告本人实际掌权窗口内、能够与既有共同体状态区分的变化；前代存量、后世独立发展和其他轴已经承担的结果不重复计算。
